title: Cardiology: reflection and OSCE prompts
description: ECG, chest pain and examination practice.

questions.q: Describe the order I use to interpret an ECG.
questions.answer: Model: patient details, rate, rhythm, axis, P wave, PR interval, QRS, ST segment, T wave, QT.

questions.q: OSCE: Take a history from a patient with chest pain.
questions.answer: Model: SOCRATES, associated symptoms, risk factors, past history, drugs, family and social history, red flags.
Model: introduce, hands, pulse, BP, JVP, face, praecordium (inspect, palpate, auscultate), peripheral oedema, thank the patient.
